id./param/scenario/cs/b_080_cs_220.pack|cs_: "Those eyes... The gentle light in them... Can it be...!
"I see... It was you who freed me from the brink of despair. You've grown fine, {var:1}...!
"...Ah, I can't believe it. Is it you, Eleanor...
The curse that tormented you was freed by {var:1}. Now we can depart in peace...
Many hardships will still stand before you. Even so, keep going straight ahead.
The light of hope within you will surely guide you. Your father and I will always watch over you.
"Oh, the Luminary's mark is shining...! Irwin and Eleanor revived the Luminary's power...
"Come, true Luminary {var:1}! This time, victory will be ours!
With the Luminary's power revived, {var:1}'s Character Builder panels were newly unlocked!"
